comment: The body's ACTION is a DECISION, not a world call. Every tick, while alive, (deliberating), it scores its options -- EAT (pull = hunger, gated by holding food, the world's affordance) and REST (pull = how depleted it is) -- then COLLAPSES (Argmax) to the strongest pull above threshold and acts. The world provides information (hunger/fatigue) + affordances (food held); the AGENT decides -- INCLUDING whether to do an acquisition ITSELF or ASK SOMEONE, one decision over routes, not a separate delegation faculty. It also decides to BUY FOOD FOR LATER (ACQUIRE) from its PROJECTED future needs -- it understands it and its dependents will get hungry over the days ahead, so it provisions (the point of food).

rules.name: bc_score_eat
rules.comment: Body decision -- the EAT option's pull = how hungry you are (hunger_level*HUNGER_SCALE) GATED by the affordance (you hold edible food); 0 if the world offers no food. Only on the agent's turn. ZERO for household members -- they eat from the SHARED store (hh_eat), not their own transit inventory.

rules.name: bc_score_rest
rules.comment: Body decision -- the REST option's pull = how depleted you are (capacity - reserve). ZERO while EN ROUTE AND ABLE (going_to with stamina above the exhaustion floor) -- you do not rest while walking. But when EXHAUSTED (reserve <= min) you stop to catch your breath and rest, even mid-journey, then walk on. Travel tires you; you rest when spent or arrived.

rules.name: bc_choose
rules.comment: Body decision -- THE COLLAPSE: the agent picks the action with the greatest pull, an Argmax over its may_do options (eat vs rest), reading the value each scored from body-state + affordance. Sets chosen_action = the winner's kind and chosen_val = its pull. Never a threshold -- a choice between competing stances (the same Argmax family as nd_choose_good). Only on the agent's turn.

rules.name: bc_do_eat
rules.comment: Body decision -> act: if the agent CHOSE to eat and the pull clears the act threshold, it EATS one held food -- consume a unit + mint a Meal (bd_meal_feeds then relieves hunger). Resets the choice so the next turn re-decides. The agent eating BY ITS OWN DECISION, not a world call.

rules.name: bc_do_rest
rules.comment: Body decision -> act: if the agent CHOSE to rest and the pull clears the threshold, it RESTS -- recovering stamina_reserve toward capacity. Resets the choice. The agent resting BY ITS OWN DECISION.

rules.name: bc_score_acquire
rules.comment: Body decision -- the ACQUIRE need = max(provision-for-later shortfall [capped], IMMEDIATE [hungry + no food, ~hunger]), gated by SOME route plausibly existing (I know a source for what I provision, or someone I could ask). WINNING mints a fetch task; the PURSUIT routes it (myself vs ask). The need, not the means -- the means is one pursuit for every goal. ZERO if the agent is in a HOUSEHOLD -- there the household provisions once and one member fetches, not each member separately.

rules.name: bc_expect_source
rules.comment: Body decision -- the affordance to provision is EXPECTATION-driven, generic, NOT co-location: the agent holds an expectation that some source has food (agent -expects-> Expect{avail} -source-> holder). Being at a shop is NOT required -- you plan from where you EXPECT to get food. Sets can_provision for the turn (live() clears it).

rules.name: bc_want_food
rules.comment: Body decision -> the acquire action MINTS A GOAL: when the agent chose to acquire, it forms a wants_done fetch task for the good it provisions (unless one is already pending). The unified PURSUIT then meets it -- go myself or ask someone. Acquiring food is a task like any other.
